subject: CAIQ claim footnotes, evidence index and rapid intake
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@verdantbank.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@verdantbank.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — scope and preferred evidence set

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this on. Verdant is running a CSA/CAIQ review next month and we'd like to take a lean approach for the initial intake so our auditors can start sampling quickly. Attached is the CAIQ export and a short ask doc.

Can you provide: 
- An annotated CAIQ claims spreadsheet that cites specific artifacts for each claim (preferably a single sheet per control family),
- A prioritized list of ~25 controls we should expect to sample first, and
- A minimal evidence kit for the prioritized controls (logs, config snapshots, attestations).

Target timeline: initial annotated sheet and prioritized controls by EOD Friday (3 business days). The auditors will ask for direct log extracts for a small set of items so include runnable pointers (Drive links or DocuSign access).

Also let me know if we need an NDA/DocuSign for sharing runtime logs.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior IT Risk Manager
Verdant Bank

Attachment: VerdantBank_CSA_Request_20260728.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@verdantbank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — scope and preferred evidence set

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the CAIQ export. We can support that intake and will deliver a "minimal evidence kit" plus an annotated claims workbook. Planned deliverables (first pass):

1) CAIQ-claim-annotations-verdant-20260730.xlsx — annotated claims with claim-to-artifact footnotes and quick retrieval instructions
2) evidence-index-verdant-v1.csv — one-line artifact index (owner, location, retention note)
3) a prioritized control list and sampling rationale (top 25)

Owners I’m assigning internally below; we can adjust if any conflicts:
- Priyom Das: runtime telemetry extracts + instrumentation proofs (KV cache, request routing traces)
- Marissa Cole: control narratives, SOC/Security attestations, access reviews
- Kimberly Park: configuration snapshots, key management (KMS/HSM) attestations and residency notes

Delivery plan: initial files by EOD Friday as requested; log samples (where requested) will be delivered via DocuSign/secure link once the NDA is in place. I’m attaching the first-pass workbook and index for your intake.

Related links: internal drive folder (shared view), DocuSign link for NDA listed below.

If Verdant’s auditors need a short walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-min call Monday morning.

Regards,
Mike Grant
Director, Applied Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ-claim-annotations-verdant-20260730.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), evidence-index-verdant-v1.csv (text/csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 12:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — scope and preferred evidence set

Thanks Mike — I’ll take the telemetry and runtime extracts. Quick notes for the index and retrieval: 
- I’ll provide a sanitized runtime log sample (30-day window, redacted tokens) and the extraction command used (kubectl exec -> gzip stream) so auditors can reproduce.
- For KV/prefix cache claims, I’ll add a short trace (request id -> cache hit logs) and the relevant kernel selection note.
- ETA for my artifacts: 48 hours. I’ll drop the sample into the drive folder with a checksum file.

Marissa — can you confirm you have the last access review for the named control owners? Kimberly — can you pull KMS rotation logs for the last six months and note any external HSM interactions?

I’ll annotate each CAIQ cell with the artifact name and path (sheet column: EvidencePath). Use the index to reconcile claims -> artifacts.

—Priyom
Staff Engineer, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
